Amumu.escape: Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so when Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down, you have a chance to go in with Shaco Q Deceive. If both stuns are available and a kill isn’t certain, save Shaco Q Deceive to escape.
Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, keep your distance from allies and spread out in open areas. Lure the fight toward an area where you’ve placed Shaco W Jack In The Box, then send in the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate to gauge Amumu’s response. After Amumu uses R Curse of the Sad Mummy, if the enemy damage dealers move forward, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind them from the flank.
Amumu.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of the enemy’s retreat path. While Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered attack. Keep attacking from behind, then finish him with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison when his health is low.
Amumu.build: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy lock you down, Shaco Q Deceive can’t get you out, so prioritize considering Quicksilver Sash. Build magic resistance instead of armor, and avoid stacking only health because of Amumu W Despair.
Amumu.fight: Engage after Amumu uses Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind Amumu and land an empowered attack. During the chase, save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to maintain your basic attack slow, then throw it as a finisher when health has dropped. If you’re not sure you can kill him, save Shaco Q Deceive to escape.
Amumu.laning: Early on, place Shaco W Jack In The Box first, then clear jungle camps to preserve your health. When invading, place Shaco W Jack In The Box in front of the enemy camp to watch for anyone approaching.
Amumu.phase: In the mid game, Shaco’s burst is strong once he has two items, so look for a chance to get behind Amumu. In the late game, Shaco’s ability to fight alone falls off, so use Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate to disrupt vision and positioning.
Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, it stuns you and lets Amumu close in, so keep a jungle monster between you and him. Amumu W Despair deals damage based on your max health while you’re nearby, so don’t stay close for long.

Belveth.phase: Early on, Bel'Veth is weak without stacks, so Shaco should gain an early advantage through invades and ganks. In the mid game, Shaco’s burst peaks once he has two items, but as Bel'Veth stacks Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender, it becomes harder to kill her from the same angle. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in one-on-one fights, so use boxes and the clone to disrupt vision as you prepare for fights.
Belveth.build: If Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet’s healing lets her survive your burst, buy Executioner's Calling early. Build armor first against Bel'Veth’s main sources of damage, Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet’s true damage can’t be reduced by resistances, so consider your total health as well.
Belveth.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along Bel'Veth’s retreat path. Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then, while Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind her and land an empowered attack. Continue attacking after Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends, and throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison as a finisher when health has dropped.
Belveth.escape: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then engage immediately after Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is spent, before her dash in the direction she dashed in becomes available again. At that moment, block Bel'Veth’s escape route with Shaco W Jack In The Box or the fear from Shaco R Hallucinate. If you aren’t sure you can kill her, save Shaco Q Deceive to escape.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below; the window to engage is before Bel'Veth Q Void Surge comes back up. Don’t use your burst during Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom; attack after it ends. If you use Shaco Q Deceive to engage, you have no way to escape that fight, so go in only when you’re sure you can kill her.
Belveth.laning: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box first, then clear camps to preserve your health.
Belveth.teamfight: Lure the fight toward terrain where you’ve placed Shaco W Jack In The Box, then send in the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate to draw attention. If an ally dies and leaves Void Coral, retreat before Bel'Veth can pick it up, and delay the team fight while Bel'Veth’s transformation is active.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge’s cooldown, so sidestep when she closes in. Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom reduces the damage she takes while it spins, so save Shaco’s burst until it ends. Be especially careful at low health because Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet heals and deals true damage.

Lillia.fight: Do not force a chase while Lillia is building movement speed with hits from her abilities. Dodge her abilities and wait until she has no stacks; right after Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind her and deal brief damage. Save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison during the chase to maintain your attack slow, then throw it as a finisher when her health is low.
Lillia.build: If Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough's healing leaves you short of the damage needed to kill her, buy Executioner's Calling early. Build magic resistance first against Lillia's main damage, and consider armor to withstand her basic attacks as well. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, while Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough scales with maximum health, so be careful about choosing to stack health alone.
Lillia.combo: Right after Lillia uses Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, place Shaco W Jack In The Box on her escape path and approach from behind with Shaco Q Deceive. Start with Shaco Q Deceive's empowered attack, then continue basic attacking from behind; use Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison as a finisher when health has decreased. If you need to catch Lillia, use Shaco R Hallucinate's clone and fear as well.
Lillia.escape: Your window to engage is when Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down and Lillia has not built movement speed with ability hits. If you risk becoming a sleep target after being hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed, save Shaco Q Deceive to escape. If you use Shaco Q Deceive to engage first, you cannot escape that fight, so go in only when you are sure of the kill.
Lillia.laning: Early on, place Shaco W Jack In The Box first to clear jungle camps safely, then use the health you preserved for ganks and jungle invades. If you do not know Lillia's location, do not pass straight through narrow jungle entrances or river passages. When ganking, place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time on the enemy's retreat path and approach from behind.
Lillia.phase: Mid game, once Shaco has two items, is when his burst is strongest, so look for chances to catch Lillia without movement speed stacks. Shaco's solo fighting power falls off late, so use Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate to establish vision and create angles to engage.
Lillia.teamfight: Do not engage head-on; fight on terrain where you placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time. Save the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box to catch Lillia as she comes in from the side. Use the Shaco R Hallucinate clone to draw attention, then use Shaco Q Deceive from the side to get behind the enemy when Lillia uses a mobility ability or the enemy backline steps forward.
Lillia.watch: If Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed hits you, she gains movement speed stacks and may make you a target of Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so dodge them even when your health is high. Be especially wary of Lillia E Swirlseed in narrow passages, and move sideways out of the center when you see the windup for Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! If you are caught by Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, use Shaco Q Deceive to reach safety while you can still move before falling asleep.

Ekko.laning: Early on, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear jungle camps safely and preserve your health. For ganks, place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of the enemy’s retreat path or in a bush first, then use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind them. If you see the cast cue for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, don’t enter its area.
Ekko.build: If Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun catches you and he follows up, get tenacity first and build magic resistance. If Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing makes it hard to finish him with burst, buy Executioner's Calling early.
Ekko.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along the enemy’s retreat path. Use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind Ekko and land an empowered attack. During the chase, save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to maintain the basic attack slow. When Ekko’s health has dropped, finish him with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, don’t rush in because Ekko can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak. Close the distance with Shaco Q Deceive during the window when both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. Right after Ekko E Phase Dive, look for a chance to catch him while his mobility is unavailable with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate.
Ekko.fight: Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s area and watch whether he uses Ekko E Phase Dive. Right after Ekko E Phase Dive, counter with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box, then fully engage once Ekko R Chronobreak is down. If you can’t be sure of the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive to escape.
Ekko.phase: In the mid game, Shaco’s burst peaks once he has two items, so take advantage of opportunities when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. In the late game, Shaco’s ability to fight alone falls off, so use Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate to create vision and an angle to engage.
Ekko.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on; lure the fight toward terrain where you’ve placed Shaco W Jack In The Box. Send in the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate to draw attention, then use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind the enemy from the flank. Right after Ekko E Phase Dive, look for a chance to interrupt him with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate.
Ekko.watch: When you see the cast cue for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, avoid the marked area to prevent its stun and shield. Watch the direction Ekko Q Timewinder travels, then move out of the way of its return path as well. When you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don’t chase recklessly even when health is low.

Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush charges in, stuns, and reduces resistances, so keep your distance to avoid it. When Briar E Chilling Scream starts charging, don’t stand with your back to a wall; look for a chance to interrupt the charge with the fear from a pre-placed Shaco W Jack In The Box. If Briar R Certain Death hits you and makes you her prey, move toward your allies and fight back together instead of trying to escape alone.
Briar.build: Build armor first because Briar’s main damage is physical. If healing from Briar P Crimson Curse, Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and similar sources lets her survive Shaco’s burst, get Executioner's Calling early. If stuns and fears make it difficult to escape with Shaco Q Deceive, consider Quicksilver Sash.
Briar.combo: First place Shaco W Jack In The Box along Briar’s retreat path. After Briar’s dash options are spent, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind her and land an empowered attack. Use Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison as a finisher when health has dropped.
Briar.escape: Don’t go in just because Briar Q Head Rush is down; look for an opening after she has also used Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. In particular, there is a window to engage before Briar R Certain Death comes back up. Close the distance with Shaco Q Deceive when Briar’s stun options are also spent, but account for having no way to escape that fight if you use it to engage.
Briar.fight: During Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, she heads toward the nearest enemy, so place Shaco W Jack In The Box along her approach ahead of time to fear her. Get behind her from the flank after she has used both Briar Q Head Rush and Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. During the chase, save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to maintain the basic attack slow, then throw it as a finisher when health has dropped.
Briar.laning: Early on, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear jungle camps safely and preserve your health. Briar is involved in many early ganks and tends to engage recklessly, so don’t linger in areas without vision; place boxes along her approach routes to prepare a counterattack.
Briar.phase: In the mid game, Shaco’s burst is at its strongest once he has two items, so look for an advantage while Briar’s engage abilities are down. In the late game, Shaco’s ability to fight alone falls off, so use boxes and the clone to disrupt vision and set up a place to fight.
Briar.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on; lure the fight toward terrain where you’ve placed Shaco W Jack In The Box. Since Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack targets the nearest enemy, position behind your team’s frontline. Send in the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate to draw attention, then, if the enemy backline moves forward, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind them from the flank.

Fiddlesticks.combo: Pre-place Shaco W Jack In The Box along Fiddlesticks’ retreat path. Use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered attack, then throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to finish him when his health is low. If Fiddlesticks uses W Bountiful Harvest, interrupt the channel with the box’s fear.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind him and land an empowered attack. When Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest starts, interrupt the channel with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box to delay his healing and next cast. If you can’t secure the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive, which has a long cooldown, for disengaging.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm are area-of-effect abilities, so spread out from your allies and don’t group up to fight in narrow terrain. Pre-place Shaco W Jack In The Box on the approach, then send in the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate to gauge Fiddlesticks’ response. When the clone explodes and applies fear, or the enemy backline moves forward, use Shaco Q Deceive from the flank to get behind them with the real Shaco.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm enters the fight after channeling. If you see it being cast, interrupt it with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box; if you can’t, move out of range. If Fiddlesticks disappears from vision, watch for an ambush from a brush, and don’t group up in narrow paths without vision. Fiddlesticks E Reap silences targets hit in the center, so avoid the middle of your formation.
Fiddlesticks.build: If Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest’s healing makes it hard to finish him with burst, buy Executioner's Calling early. Build magic resistance instead of armor against Fiddlesticks’ damage.
Fiddlesticks.escape: Once you’ve confirmed that Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap are both down, go in with a reduced risk of being caught by crowd control.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Maintain vision in the bushes behind the lane, and don’t walk close to a stationary Fiddlesticks P A Harmless Scarecrow until you’ve confirmed whether it’s the real Fiddlesticks.
Fiddlesticks.phase: In the mid game, Shaco’s burst is at its strongest once he has two items, so look for a chance to pick off Fiddlesticks when he’s alone. In the late game, Shaco’s ability to fight alone falls off, so use boxes and the clone to pressure vision and approach routes.

Brand.build: Build magic resistance first against Brand’s damage. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your max health, so consider movement speed to get out of telegraphed areas like Brand W Pillar of Flame instead of only stacking health.
Brand.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along Brand’s retreat path. When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered attack. Save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison during the chase, then use it to finish Brand when his health has dropped.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility ability, so immediately after Brand W Pillar of Flame is spent is your chance to close the distance. If you’re ablaze, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear or wait until the fire goes out before engaging. If you use Shaco Q Deceive to go in, it’s hard to escape that fight, so first assess whether you’re in a position to get the kill.
Brand.fight: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and you aren’t ablaze, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind Brand. Brand has no mobility ability and tends to have low magic resistance, so land an empowered attack from behind and stay on him to apply pressure. If a kill isn’t certain, save Shaco Q Deceive to escape.
Brand.laning: Early on, place Shaco W Jack In The Box first and clear camps to preserve your health, then use it for ganks. If Brand has ignited a minion, don’t stand next to it. Look for an opening after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down.
Brand.phase: In the mid game, once Shaco has two items, his burst is at its strongest, so look for Brand after he uses his poke abilities. In the late game, Shaco’s ability to fight alone falls off, so use boxes and the clone to establish vision and create an angle to engage.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from allies to avoid the spread from Brand E Conflagration and the bounces from Brand R Pyroclasm. Lure the fight toward terrain where you’ve placed Shaco W Jack In The Box, then send in the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate to gauge Brand’s response.
Brand.watch: If Brand Q Sear hits you after Brand P Blaze is applied, it stuns you, so move out of the projectile’s path while you’re ablaze. Dodging Brand W Pillar of Flame first also reduces the risk of Blaze stacks continuing to build. When Brand R Pyroclasm appears, spread out from allies to avoid its bounces.

Diana.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can get out of telegraphed attack areas. If you need resistances, build magic resistance against Diana’s magic damage.
Diana.combo: First place Shaco W Jack In The Box along the enemy’s retreat path. If Diana W Pale Cascade is down and she has also used Diana E Lunar Rush, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind her and land an empowered attack. Throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to finish the opponent when their health has dropped.
Diana.escape: The window to engage is right after Diana uses Diana E Lunar Rush to go in without a Diana Q Crescent Strike mark. Start the fight after fearing her with Shaco W Jack In The Box or slowing her with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison. If you’re marked, create distance in case she re-engages and save Shaco Q Deceive to escape.
Diana.fight: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike, then fight after Diana W Pale Cascade’s orbs and shield are gone. If Diana E Lunar Rush is used without a mark, fear her with Shaco W Jack In The Box, get behind her, and attack. During the chase, save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to maintain the slow, then throw it as a finisher when health has dropped.
Diana.laning: Use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear early camps safely and preserve your health. Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of the enemy’s retreat path.
Diana.phase: In the mid game, once Shaco has two items, his burst is strong; in the late game, use boxes and the clone to disrupt vision and apply pressure.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from allies so multiple players aren’t pulled in by Diana R Moonfall, and place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of Diana’s flank route. Send in the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate to draw attention, then have Shaco’s real body wait on the flank.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so dodge to the side. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush may become available again, so create distance. Don’t close in right after Diana W Pale Cascade activates; wait for the orbs and shield to disappear.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main damage. If Elise P Spider Queen’s healing makes it hard to finish her with burst, consider Executioner's Calling early. If you’re frequently caught by Elise E Cocoon, consider Quicksilver Sash as well.
Elise.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of Elise’s retreat route or where she’ll land. Once Elise E Cocoon and E Rappel are down, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind her and land an empowered attack, then finish her with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison.
Elise.escape: Immediately after you force Elise to use Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite is a chance to close the distance, but be cautious about engaging with Shaco Q Deceive while Elise E Cocoon is still available. If both Cocoon and E Rappel are down when you engage, it’s hard for Elise to get away.
Elise.fight: Start a fight after both Elise E Cocoon and Elise R Spider Form E Rappel are down. Use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind her and deal Shaco P Backstab damage. Use Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to finish the opponent when their health has dropped.
Elise.laning: Maintain vision to avoid giving up kills to Elise’s early ganks, and don’t push your lane recklessly while Elise is missing.
Elise.phase: Early on, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to farm safely while watching out for Elise, who looks to gain an advantage through ganks. Shaco’s burst gets strong in the mid game once he has two items, so look for chances to pick enemies off then. In the late game, use boxes and the clone to disrupt vision and apply pressure rather than fighting alone.
Elise.teamfight: Lure the fight toward terrain where you’ve placed Shaco W Jack In The Box, and avoid engaging head-on. Send the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate toward the enemy backline to draw a response, then, as the clone explodes and fears them, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind them from the flank.
Elise.watch: When health is high, watch out for Elise Q Neurotoxin; when health has dropped and Elise changes into Elise R Spider Form, be especially wary of her finishing attack.

Evelynn.build: If Evelynn P Demon Shade's healing makes it hard to finish her with Shaco's burst, buy Executioner's Calling early. Prioritize magic resistance against Evelynn's main damage, but don't rely on health alone: Evelynn W Allure reduces resistance, and Evelynn E Whiplash deals damage based on the target's maximum health.
Evelynn.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along Evelynn's likely path or retreat route. Use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind her and land an empowered basic attack, then throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison as a finisher when health has dropped. If you're responding to Evelynn engaging, use Shaco R Hallucinate as another way to apply fear.
Evelynn.escape: Don't engage while the mark from Evelynn W Allure is maturing; back away. Evelynn can escape with E Whiplash and R Last Caress, so don't chase just because she's used one of them. Look especially for a chance before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up. Then close the gap with Shaco Q Deceive and block her escape with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate.
Evelynn.fight: Back away while the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, and place Shaco W Jack In The Box in her likely approach path ahead of time. When Evelynn R Last Caress is down and you can secure the kill, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind her and deal a quick burst. If you don't have a clear chance to kill her, save Shaco Q Deceive, which has a long cooldown, for escaping.
Evelynn.laning: Keep a Control Ward ready and also place vision beside the camp where Evelynn will start a fight.
Evelynn.phase: Shaco's burst is strong in the mid game once he has two items, so look for fights before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up. Shaco's ability to fight alone falls off in the late game, so use boxes and your clone to create vision and find angles to engage.
Evelynn.teamfight: Fight in areas where you have vision so your allied damage dealers aren't exposed to Evelynn, and place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along her route for engaging from the rear. If Evelynn goes in, catch her with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate. Instead of engaging from the front, draw attention with your clone, then look for the enemy backline from the side.
Evelynn.watch: When you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, Evelynn is nearby preparing to charm you. Back away before the mark matures and alert your allies.

Gragas.build: If Gragas P Happy Hour's healing lets him withstand Shaco's burst, buy Executioner's Calling early. Against Gragas's damage, prioritize magic resistance over armor. Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on maximum health, so don't rely on health alone.
Gragas.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time on the enemy's retreat route and wait for Gragas E Body Slam to be down. Use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind Gragas and land an empowered basic attack, then finish with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison when health drops. Use Shaco R Hallucinate when you need to prevent Gragas from escaping again.
Gragas.escape: The moment after Gragas E Body Slam is down is your chance to engage with Shaco Q Deceive. It's also a good time to burst him if the damage reduction from Gragas W Drunken Rage has ended. If you can't secure the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive for escaping.
Gragas.fight: Save your burst while Gragas is drinking with W Drunken Rage, then attack after the damage reduction ends. When Gragas E Body Slam is down, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind him and land an empowered basic attack. While chasing, hold Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to keep the basic attack slow, then throw it to finish him once his health has decreased.
Gragas.laning: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along a gank route or the enemy's retreat path. Only chase an enemy far when they escape with Gragas E Body Slam if you can secure the kill.
Gragas.phase: Shaco's burst is strong in the mid game, but Gragas also has strong burst and formation disruption in the early and mid game, so look for an opening when Gragas E Body Slam is down. In the late game, Gragas's sustained damage weakens, while Shaco's ability to fight alone also falls off, so use boxes and your clone to disrupt vision as you fight.
Gragas.teamfight: Don't engage from the front; draw the fight toward terrain where you've placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time. Send Shaco R Hallucinate's clone forward to draw attention, then, when Gragas E Body Slam is down and an enemy damage dealer steps forward, use Shaco Q Deceive from the side to get behind them. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you, don't fight back where you are; move outside the radius of Gragas Q Barrel Roll.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius before it explodes. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you near the barrel, it's easy to get hit by both abilities. When Gragas has R Explosive Cask available, don't stand with an enemy turret or the enemy formation behind you.

Graves.build: Graves's main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. Buy Plated Steelcaps early for skirmishes in the early and mid game.
Graves.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along Graves's retreat path or in a brush. When Graves's mobility is down, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered basic attack, then finish him with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison.
Graves.escape: Don't rush in when only Graves E Quickdraw is down, since he can still escape with Graves R Collateral Damage. Look especially for a chance before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back up: close the gap with Shaco Q Deceive and follow up with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate. If it's hard to secure the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive for escaping.
Graves.fight: Counterattack or create distance while Graves reloads after firing both shots. If you have Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison ready, its basic attack slow lets you chase, so throw it to finish him once his health has decreased. Get behind him to make use of Shaco P Backstab, and fight in open terrain where it's easier to dodge Graves Q End of the Line.
Graves.laning: Use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear camps safely and preserve your health, then pressure Graves with early ganks and jungle invades. Place Shaco W Jack In The Box in front of enemy camps to establish vision and limit the time Graves has to build stacks with E Quickdraw.
Graves.phase: Shaco's burst is strong in the mid game once he has two items, so pressure Graves then. Graves's stacks build over time, putting you at a disadvantage, and Shaco's ability to fight alone also falls off, so disrupt vision in the late game with Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate.
Graves.teamfight: Draw the fight toward terrain where you've placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time, but avoid narrow paths where Graves Q End of the Line explodes immediately. Send Shaco R Hallucinate's clone forward to draw attention; when an enemy damage dealer steps forward, use Shaco Q Deceive from the side to get behind them with your real body. Use the moment the clone explodes and fears enemies as your signal to engage.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line explodes immediately when it hits terrain, so don't fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow jungle path. If you're caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, your vision is blocked and you're slowed; leave its area by the shortest route, then re-engage. Graves P New Destiny's basic attacks are blocked by the first unit they hit, so put a minion or an ally between you and Graves in a skirmish.

Hecarim.build: If Hecarim W Spirit of Dread's healing makes your burst insufficient, buy Executioner's Calling early. Hecarim's main damage from Q Rampage and E Devastating Charge is physical, so prioritize armor for resistance.
Hecarim.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along the enemy's retreat path or in a brush. Use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind Hecarim and land an empowered basic attack, then throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison as a finisher once health has decreased. While chasing, holding E ready keeps your basic attack slow up.
Hecarim.escape: Don't rush in when only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, since he can escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows. Look especially for a chance before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back up: close the gap with Shaco Q Deceive and block his escape with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box and R Hallucinate.
Hecarim.fight: When Hecarim approaches, hinder his movement with Shaco W Jack In The Box or E Two-Shiv Poison to also reduce the attack damage he gains from Hecarim P Warpath. Don't trade for long inside Hecarim W Spirit of Dread; leave its area, then burst him briefly to finish the fight. If you can't secure the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive for escaping.
Hecarim.laning: Place boxes in front of enemy camps as well to prepare for an invade.
Hecarim.phase: The mid game, once Shaco has two items, is the peak of his burst. In the late game, pressure with boxes and your clone to disrupt vision rather than fight alone.
Hecarim.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn't fear several of you, and draw the fight toward terrain where you've placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time. Send Shaco R Hallucinate's clone forward to draw attention, while your real body waits to the side; when an enemy damage dealer steps forward, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind them. If Hecarim charges in, hinder his movement with boxes and Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks you back farther the farther he has run, so break vision or move toward an ally when he creates distance to start running. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple people, so don't group up with allies. Don't fight near Hecarim for long while W Spirit of Dread is active; back out of its area.

Ivern.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along the enemy's retreat route and bait Ivern into using Q Rootcaller. Throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to finish your target once their health has decreased.
Ivern.escape: The moment after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down is your window to close the gap with Shaco Q Deceive. If you don't have a clear chance to secure the kill, though, save Shaco Q Deceive, which has a long cooldown, for escaping. To avoid the root, position yourself with terrain between you and Ivern ahead of time.
Ivern.fight: Look for an engage after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down and Ivern E Triggerseed has exploded. Use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind your target and land an empowered basic attack. While chasing, hold Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to keep the basic attack slow, then finish once health has decreased. Rather than chasing Ivern, who can shield allies, too far, look for a chance to pick off an ally he's protecting.
Ivern.laning: Watch for ambushes around brushes that appear suddenly from Ivern W Brushmaker.
Ivern.phase: Shaco's burst is strongest in the mid game, so pick off targets when Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern E Triggerseed are down. Shaco's ability to fight alone falls off in the late game, so use boxes and your clone to disrupt vision and create angles to engage.
Ivern.teamfight: Don't engage from the front; draw the fight toward terrain where you've placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time. Send Shaco R Hallucinate's clone forward to draw attention, then, when Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern E Triggerseed are down and an enemy damage dealer steps forward, use Shaco Q Deceive from the side to get behind them with your real body. Move away if Ivern R Daisy! is landing consecutive attacks on you.
Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller hits you, you're rooted and Ivern's allies can dash in, so use terrain to block the angle before he casts it. Delay your engage on a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed until the slow after the explosion ends. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, move to break her consecutive attacks and knock-up.
Ivern.build: The specific first item to buy can't be determined from the available information alone. Against Ivern, prioritize tenacity to account for the risk of allies joining in on roots and knock-ups. If you build resistance, prioritize magic resistance to match Ivern's magic damage.

JarvanIV.combo: Throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to finish your target once their health has decreased.
JarvanIV.escape: If you aren't sure you can secure the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive, which has a long cooldown, for escaping.
JarvanIV.fight: Use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind your target and land an empowered basic attack. While chasing, hold Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to keep your basic attack slow up.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Don't engage from the front; draw the fight toward terrain where you've placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time. Send Shaco R Hallucinate's clone toward the enemy backline to draw a response, then use Shaco Q Deceive from the side to get behind them with your real body.

Jax.build: Jax's basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, so prioritize items that reduce his attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. If you are often caught by Jax E Counter Strike's stun, consider Quicksilver Sash as well.
Jax.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along Jax's retreat path. When Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike are down, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered basic attack, then finish him with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison.
Jax.escape: The moment after Jax Q Leap Strike is used is your chance to close the gap. If Jax E Counter Strike is also down, engage with Shaco Q Deceive and block his escape with Shaco W Jack In The Box. If Jax E Counter Strike is still available, save Shaco Q Deceive for escaping so you can avoid the stun.
Jax.fight: Look for a trade after Jax E Counter Strike is down. Don't basic attack during Counter Strike; leave the stun's range, then use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind him and land an empowered basic attack after it ends. While chasing, hold Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to keep your basic attack slow up, then throw it to finish Jax once his health has decreased.
Jax.phase: Shaco's ability to fight alone falls off in the late game, so disrupt vision and apply pressure with Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, don't group up nearby; avoid the area stun. Draw the fight toward Shaco W Jack In The Box that you placed ahead of time, and use Shaco R Hallucinate's clone to draw attention. When Jax E Counter Strike ends and an enemy damage dealer steps forward, use Shaco Q Deceive from the side to get behind them.
Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, your basic attacks are negated, and its recast damage increases with each attack evaded.

Karthus.build: The provided material gives no basis for specifying your first item purchase. Karthus deals magic damage, so choose magic resistance if you build resistances. However, movement speed to dodge Karthus W Wall of Pain and the area of Karthus E Defile takes priority over adding more resistance.
Karthus.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time on Karthus's retreat path or in a bush. Use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered basic attack from stealth. Throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison as a finisher once health has decreased. After killing Karthus, do not stay near his body.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no mobility, so use Shaco Q Deceive to engage when you have a route around Karthus W Wall of Pain and can secure the kill. If you cannot be sure of the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive to escape, and move around the wall when it appears.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no skill to create distance, so engage when Shaco Q Deceive lets you get behind him. Land an empowered basic attack from stealth from behind, and save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison during the chase to maintain the basic attack slow before finishing once health has decreased. After a kill, leave immediately to avoid the spells cast by Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.laning: Shaco uses Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear early camps safely and preserve health.
Karthus.phase: Mid game is when Shaco's burst is strongest, but Karthus can catch up with fast farming if he gets through the early game. Shaco's solo fighting power falls off late, so use boxes and your clone to disrupt vision and create an opening to engage.
Karthus.teamfight: Draw the fight toward terrain where you placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time, and avoid engaging head-on. Send the Shaco R Hallucinate clone toward Karthus to draw his attention, then use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind him from another direction. Even after killing Karthus, Karthus P Death Defied can still deal damage, so reposition immediately.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so walk out of its marked area. Karthus W Wall of Pain slows you and reduces your magic resistance if you pass through it, so go around the wall. After killing Karthus, move away from his body immediately to avoid the spells cast by Karthus P Death Defied, and keep enough health after a fight to survive Karthus R Requiem.

Kayn.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, Kayn W Blade's Reach, and Kayn R Umbral Trespass. If Kayn is in his Rhaast form, which has sustained healing, buy Executioner's Calling early so he can't sustain himself by healing between Shaco's brief bursts.
Kayn.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along Kayn's retreat path. When Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn R Umbral Trespass are down, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered basic attack. While chasing, hold Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to keep your basic attack slow up, then throw it once health has decreased.
Kayn.escape: Don't rush in when only Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down, since he can escape with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Look especially for a chance before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back up, when you've also dodged Kayn W Blade's Reach: close the gap with Shaco Q Deceive and pressure his escape route with Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate.
Kayn.fight: Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach and engage after Kayn Q Reaping Slash and Kayn R Umbral Trespass are down. Use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind him and land an empowered basic attack, then use Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison as a finisher once health has decreased. If you aren't sure you can secure the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive for escaping.
Kayn.laning: In the early game, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear camps safely and preserve your health, then pressure Kayn's jungle route while he's weak before transforming. Place boxes in front of enemy camps and at your jungle entrances to watch for his approach, and don't continue fighting if you see Kayn's wall warning.
Kayn.phase: In the early game, Kayn is weak before transforming, so Shaco can pressure his jungle route and objectives to delay his transformation. Shaco's burst is strong in the mid game once he has two items, so look for isolated targets then. Shaco's ability to fight alone falls off in the late game, so use Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate to create vision and angles to engage.
Kayn.teamfight: Draw the fight toward terrain where you've placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time, use Shaco R Hallucinate's clone to draw attention, then look for an opening against the backline from the side. If Kayn R Umbral Trespass enters an ally, prepare boxes around the target and target the moment Kayn emerges.
Kayn.watch: Dodge the line of Kayn W Blade's Reach to prevent him from following up from long range with an engage using Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on maximum health, and if a warning appears along a wall's edge when Kayn uses E Shadow Step, stop fighting and back away.

Khazix.build: If Kha'Zix W Void Spike's healing leaves you short on burst damage, buy Executioner's Calling early.
Khazix.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time on Kha'Zix's approach. Once Kha'Zix E Leap is down, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered basic attack. Throw E Two-Shiv Poison once his health has decreased.
Khazix.escape: Immediately after Kha'Zix uses E Leap to engage is Shaco's chance to counterattack. At that moment, block his escape route with Shaco W Jack In The Box or R Hallucinate, and close the gap with Q Deceive only when you are sure you can kill him.
Khazix.fight: Do not engage first with Shaco Q Deceive before Kha'Zix E Leap is down. Control Kha'Zix with Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate right after he leaps, then use Q Deceive to get behind him and land an empowered attack before finishing with E Two-Shiv Poison.
Khazix.laning: Spend less time moving alone to avoid the isolated damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear, and place boxes ahead of time in river and jungle entrance bushes.
Khazix.phase: Shaco has strong burst in mid game once he has two items, but avoid fighting Kha'Zix alone if he has two or more evolutions. Shaco's solo fighting power falls off late, so use boxes and your clone to disrupt vision and approach routes.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with allies to prevent the isolated damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear, and do not go alone to establish vision in front of objectives. Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time on an approach, send the R Hallucinate clone forward, then engage from the side when Kha'Zix E Leap is down and an enemy damage dealer steps forward.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage when you are isolated, so stay near an ally or minion when you take the hit. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, instead of trying to find him, prepare Shaco W Jack In The Box on his likely approach and look to punish him as he reappears.

Kindred.build: If Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite healing make the duel drag on, get Executioner's Calling early.
Kindred.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time on Kindred's retreat path. After Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is down, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind Kindred and land an empowered attack, then finish with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison when Kindred's health has decreased. If needed, use Shaco R Hallucinate's clone and fear to pressure the escape route.
Kindred.escape: Do not rush to engage when only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down, since Kindred can still escape with Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy. Approach with Shaco Q Deceive before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes off cooldown, from an angle where you will not keep getting hit by the slow from Kindred E Mounting Dread.
Kindred.fight: Engage while Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is down and before it returns. Use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind Kindred and land an empowered attack. Hold Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison during the chase if you need its slow, then throw it as a finisher when health has decreased. If you cannot be sure of the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive to escape.
Kindred.laning: Early on, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear camps safely and preserve health, then use that health for ganks and jungle invades. Delay Kindred's acquisition of Mark of the Kindred marks by taking camps marked with Kindred P Mark of the Kindred first or placing Shaco W Jack In The Box nearby to watch for Kindred's approach.
Kindred.phase: Kindred is vulnerable to pressure early, so Shaco should preserve health and delay mark progress with ganks and jungle invades. Mid game, once Shaco has two items, is when his burst is strongest, so look for isolated Kindred. Shaco's solo fighting power falls off late, so use boxes and your clone to establish vision and create angles to engage.
Kindred.teamfight: Fight on terrain where you placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time, send the Shaco R Hallucinate clone forward, then look to get behind Kindred from the side. If Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, survive inside its zone and time your finisher with the healing when the zone ends in mind.
Kindred.watch: The lower your health, the greater the danger, so use Shaco Q Deceive to create distance or break vision. Kindred often uses Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside the area of Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so do not fight there for long.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first to withstand the damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor does not block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest/Cripple.
LeeSin.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time on Lee Sin's retreat path. Before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike can be used again, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered attack. Throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison as a finisher when health has decreased.
LeeSin.escape: Engage when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or is still on cooldown. Check whether Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is down too before using Shaco Q Deceive to go in; if you cannot be sure of the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive to escape.
LeeSin.fight: Do not take a head-on duel with Lee Sin early. Use Shaco Q Deceive to close the gap when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or is still on cooldown, then focus your damage right after Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is down as well.
LeeSin.laning: If you encounter Lee Sin in the jungle early, retreat and place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time at an entrance he may pass through to watch for his approach.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so Shaco should preserve health with boxes and create his first ganking opportunity. Shaco's burst becomes strong in mid game once he has two items. Lee Sin falls off late, but Shaco's solo fighting power does too, so use boxes and your clone to disrupt vision and engage angles.
LeeSin.teamfight: Do not engage head-on; draw the fight toward terrain where you placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time. Send the Shaco R Hallucinate clone forward to draw attention, then use Shaco Q Deceive from the side to get behind an enemy damage dealer when they step forward. Keep some distance from allies so you do not collide with the target hit by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.

MasterYi.build: If Master Yi W Meditate's healing delays the kill, buy Executioner's Calling early.
MasterYi.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time on Master Yi's retreat path, and use Shaco Q Deceive to engage from behind after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends. Land an empowered attack, then throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison as a finisher when health has decreased.
MasterYi.escape: Right after you bait Master Yi into using Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is your chance to engage. At that point, use Shaco Q Deceive to close the gap and look for a fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box, but save Q to escape if the kill is uncertain.
MasterYi.fight: Bait Master Yi into using Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, then look for a fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box when he lands. Use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind him and land an empowered attack, but if you cannot be sure of the kill, save Q to escape.
MasterYi.laning: Early on, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear camps safely and preserve health.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi's early jungle skirmishing and ganks are weak, so Shaco should get ahead first with ganks and objectives. Make use of Shaco's burst in mid game, and late game, when Master Yi gets stronger, use boxes and your clone to disrupt his approach instead of fighting him alone.
MasterYi.teamfight: Draw the fight toward terrain where you placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time, and avoid engaging head-on. Look for a fear when Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands to prevent him from getting involved in the first kill, then use Shaco R Hallucinate's clone to draw attention and engage from the side.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi cannot be targeted during Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so look to punish him right after it ends and he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, slows do not work, so do not try to create distance with the slow from Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison.

MonkeyKing.build: If Wukong P Stone Skin's healing lets him survive Shaco's short burst, buy Executioner's Calling early. Build armor first to block Wukong's main physical damage. However, Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor and Wukong E Nimbus Strike deals magic damage, so do not rely on armor alone in a prolonged fight.
MonkeyKing.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box first on Wukong's retreat path. After Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind the real Wukong and land an empowered basic attack; throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison as a finisher when health has decreased. Use the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or the Shaco R Hallucinate clone on Wukong's escape route.
MonkeyKing.escape: After Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down and before it returns is your chance to close the gap with Shaco Q Deceive. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike is still available, he can use it to move, so do not go deep just because one mobility ability is down. Right after Wukong R Cyclone is down, he has a harder time engaging or escaping, so look for a fight or an objective.
MonkeyKing.laning: Use the advantage of the health you preserved by placing Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time on gank routes and in the direction the enemy may retreat. If you encounter Wukong, do not stay on him long enough to build stacks of Wukong P Stone Skin.
MonkeyKing.phase: Mid game, once Shaco has two items, is when his burst is strongest, but a long fight with Wukong is unfavorable because of the stacks from Wukong P Stone Skin. Shaco's solo fighting power falls off late, so use Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate to disrupt vision and create an opening to engage.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: If Wukong R Cyclone is available, keep your distance from allies and draw the fight toward terrain where you placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time. Send the Shaco R Hallucinate clone toward the enemy backline to draw attention, then use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind them from the side. Engage when the clone explodes and applies fear or an enemy damage dealer steps forward, and pressure a fight or objective if Wukong R Cyclone is down.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash, so avoid it by staying out of range; if it hits, Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor and puts you at a disadvantage in the ensuing fight. The clone left by Wukong W Warrior Trickster stays in place, so do not use abilities on the clone; watch the direction the stealthed real Wukong is heading. Wukong R Cyclone knocks up in an area and can be recast, and the clone copies it, so keep your distance from allies while his ultimate is available.

Nidalee.build: If Nidalee sustains through fights with Nidalee E Primal Surge, buy Executioner's Calling early. The listed damage from Nidalee's attack abilities is magic, so choose magic resistance if you build defenses, but dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from range comes first.
Nidalee.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time on Nidalee's escape route after she uses Nidalee W Pounce. Use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind her and land an empowered attack, then finish with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison.
Nidalee.escape: Right after you bait Nidalee into using W Pounce is your chance to close the gap with Shaco Q Deceive. If you are marked after being hit by a spear or trap, keep Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate available to prepare for Nidalee W Pounce followed by Nidalee Q Takedown.
Nidalee.fight: Start the fight without a Hunt mark by dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack. Right after Nidalee uses W Pounce, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind her and land an empowered attack; use Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison as a finisher when health has decreased.
Nidalee.laning: Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack traps at jungle entrances and by the river, and place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along the enemy's path to check for her approach.
Nidalee.phase: Mid game, once Shaco has two items, his burst reaches its peak, so look for an opening when Nidalee W Pounce is down. Late game, use boxes and your clone to disrupt vision and create an opening to engage instead of fighting alone.
Nidalee.teamfight: Do not engage head-on; draw the fight toward terrain where you placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time. Send the Shaco R Hallucinate clone forward to draw attention, and watch where Nidalee steps out to throw her spear before using Shaco Q Deceive to get behind her from the side.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss hurts more the farther away it hits from, so dodge its path and, if possible, keep minions or your frontline between you and Nidalee. If you step on Nidalee W Bushwhack or get hit by her spear, you gain a Hunt mark and can be chased easily with Nidalee W Pounce, so watch for traps at jungle entrances and along the river as well.

Nocturne.build: If Nocturne’s healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades lets him survive Shaco’s burst, buy Executioner's Calling early. Build armor first against the physical damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Nocturne Q Duskbringer, and Nocturne R Paranoia.
Nocturne.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along Nocturne’s retreat route, then use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered basic attack. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is still available, check whether the shield is up so your fear is not blocked. During the chase, save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to maintain the basic attack slow, then throw it to finish Nocturne when his health has decreased.
Nocturne.escape: When Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is tethered to you, use Shaco Q Deceive to create distance and break the tether instead of continuing the fight. If you used Shaco Q Deceive to engage, it will be hard to escape that fight, so only go in when you can secure the kill.
Nocturne.fight: Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability, so do not engage relying on the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate while his shield is up. Get behind him and land an empowered basic attack, and use Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison as a finisher when the opponent's health has decreased.
Nocturne.laning: Secure vision around the river and jungle entrances, and position yourself so you can retreat toward your allies before Nocturne R Paranoia activates. Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along the enemy’s retreat route.
Nocturne.phase: Mid-game, Shaco’s burst is strong, so pick off a target while Nocturne R Paranoia is down. In the late game, Shaco’s solo dueling power falls off, so use boxes and your clone to create vision and an angle to engage.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, move toward your allies to avoid being isolated. Draw the fight toward terrain where you have placed Shaco W Jack In The Box and use Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone to draw attention. Keep your real body out of the front line; watch Nocturne’s engage and the status of Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness, then target the enemy backline from the side.
Nocturne.watch: If you are hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, Nocturne can quickly approach along its trail, so do not run straight away; turn toward an ally or turret. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, you will be feared, so use Shaco Q Deceive to create distance and break the tether. If Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, do not stay isolated; immediately move toward your allies.

Nunu.build: Buy Executioner's Calling early to counter the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume. Build magic resistance first against Nunu & Willump's main damage, and get tenacity to deal with the snowball's crowd control.
Nunu.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance on the enemy's retreat path or in a brush. Dodge Nunu & Willump's snowball and root, then use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind them and land an empowered basic attack, finishing with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison. When you need to block Nunu & Willump's escape route, use the clone and fear from Shaco R Hallucinate as well.
Nunu.escape: Once Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! has passed and the root threat from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage is gone, you have a chance to close the distance with Shaco Q Deceive. Nunu & Willump has no skill to create distance on their own, but if the kill isn't certain, save Shaco Q Deceive for escape instead of using it to engage.
Nunu.fight: Look for an opening after dodging Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and the root threat from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage has passed. If you can't secure the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive for escape. Use Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison's basic attack slow, then throw it as a finisher when health has decreased. Since Nunu & Willump can heal with Q Consume, it's better to finish them with a short burst after getting Executioner's Calling.
Nunu.laning: Early on, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear camps safely and preserve your health.
Nunu.phase: In mid game, once Shaco has two items, his burst is at its peak, so look for targets to pick off from the flank. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in solo fights, so use boxes and your clone to disrupt vision and create an opening to engage.
Nunu.teamfight: Don't engage from the front; draw the fight toward terrain where you've placed Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance. Send the Shaco R Hallucinate clone forward to draw attention, then when the enemy backline steps up, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind them from the flank. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, look for a chance to interrupt it with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box; if it's hard to interrupt, leave its area.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up, so secure vision around the river and dodge to the side or move onto the path Nunu & Willump came from when it approaches. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, use Shaco Q Deceive to get out immediately before the delayed root lands. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, leave its area or interrupt the channel with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about heavily stacking health alone. You don't need to prioritize magic resistance just to deal with Poppy.
Poppy.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance on Poppy's retreat path or in a brush. If Poppy E Heroic Charge has been used and Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind her and land an empowered basic attack. While chasing, hold Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison and use its slow, then throw it to finish once health has decreased.
Poppy.escape: Right after Poppy E Heroic Charge has been used is your chance to close the distance. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait for it to end, then engage with Shaco Q Deceive. If you can't secure the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive for escape.
Poppy.fight: Bait out Poppy E Heroic Charge, then use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind her once Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended. Attack from behind to make use of Shaco P Backstab, and save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison while chasing. Poppy gains armor and magic resistance as her health gets lower, so only throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison when you're sure it will finish her.
Poppy.laning: Early on, Shaco uses Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear jungle camps safely, preserve his health, then gank. Against Poppy, avoid standing with your back to walls or narrow passages to avoid the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Poppy P Iron Ambassador's buckler lands somewhere safe to step on, step on it first to deny her shield.
Poppy.phase: Shaco's burst is strongest in the mid game with two items, so take advantage of openings when Poppy's engage tools are down. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in solo fights, so pressure her by disrupting vision with Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate.
Poppy.teamfight: Draw the fight toward terrain where you've placed Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance, and avoid engaging from the front. Send the Shaco R Hallucinate clone toward the enemy backline to draw attention, then once Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended and the backline carries step forward, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind them from the flank. If Poppy R Keeper's Verdict is charging, move to the side from the front.
Poppy.watch: While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't engage with Shaco Q Deceive; wait for the effect to end. Stand in open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can't pin you against a wall and stun you. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock's first hit lands, immediately walk out of the remaining area. If Poppy R Keeper's Verdict is charging, move to the side from the front.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the main damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. If you die while locked down by the crowd control from Rammus Q Powerball into E Frenzying Taunt and R Soaring Slam, prioritize tenacity.
Rammus.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance on the enemy's retreat path. Once Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl has ended and Rammus E Frenzying Taunt has been used, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered basic attack. Save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison while chasing to keep slowing him with basic attacks, then throw it to finish once health has decreased.
Rammus.escape: If you can't secure the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive for escape instead of using it to engage.
Rammus.fight: While Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, you take reflected damage from basic attacks, so don't hit him; target someone else. Pour in damage after W ends, but don't try to wear Rammus down with prolonged physical damage. Look for an opening outside Rammus E Frenzying Taunt's range and use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind him.
Rammus.laning: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box first to clear jungle camps safely and preserve your health for ganks. If you see Rammus Q Powerball approaching, put minions between you and him, and place Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance in the brush he will pass through.
Rammus.phase: Shaco's burst is strong in the mid game with two items, so look for chances to pick off the backline. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in solo fights, so prepare for fights by disrupting vision with boxes and your clone.
Rammus.teamfight: If Rammus Q Powerball lets him approach quickly, move away with plenty of room for Rammus R Soaring Slam's range. Draw the fight toward a Shaco W Jack In The Box you've placed in advance, and send the Shaco R Hallucinate clone forward to draw the enemy's attention. Avoid engaging from the front with your main body; when the enemy backline steps up, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind them from the flank.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, put minions between you and him early, and move away from the expanded landing area of Rammus R Soaring Slam as well. The landing spot stays slowed, so leave it immediately. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents movement and skill use, so fight outside its range.

RekSai.build: Buy Executioner's Calling early if Rek'Sai is sustaining through Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai. Build armor first against Rek'Sai's main damage. Armor can't block the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush scales with your maximum health, so be careful about heavily stacking health alone.
RekSai.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box first on Rek'Sai's retreat path. Finish her with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison when her health decreases.
RekSai.escape: Look to engage after Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knockup and Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel are down. If Rek'Sai R Void Rush isn't available again yet, use Shaco Q Deceive to close the distance and pressure her escape route with Shaco W Jack In The Box and R Hallucinate. Don't rush in if only one of her mobility skills is down, since she can escape with the other.
RekSai.fight: After dodging the knockup from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, check whether Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel and R Void Rush are also down before engaging. Use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind her and land a basic attack empowered by Shaco P Backstab. Save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison while chasing to keep slowing her with basic attacks, then throw it to finish once the enemy's health has decreased.
RekSai.laning: Don't move alone through areas without vision, so Rek'Sai can't get kills with her early and mid game ganks. Step on visible tunnel entrances as you pass to remove Rek'Sai's gank routes and escape paths.
RekSai.phase: Early on, watch for Rek'Sai's ganks, clear the jungle safely with Shaco W Jack In The Box, and look for your first gank opportunity. Shaco's burst is strongest in the mid game with two items, so pick Rek'Sai off when her mobility and knockup are down. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in solo fights, so create vision and engage angles with boxes and your clone.
RekSai.teamfight: Don't engage from the front; draw the fight toward terrain where you've placed Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance. Send the Shaco R Hallucinate clone forward to draw attention, and use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind the enemy carries from the flank when they step up. Wait to engage if Rek'Sai still has her knockup.
RekSai.watch: When Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow puts her underground, watch for the knockup as she emerges. Move toward open space; you can use Shaco Q Deceive to dodge as she comes up, but then it will be hard to escape that fight. Immediately after Rek'Sai damages you, watch out for Rek'Sai R Void Rush as well, and stay close to your allies.

Rengar.build: Buy Executioner's Calling early if Rengar W Battle Roar's healing makes it hard to finish him with Shaco's short burst. Rengar's main damage is physical, so build armor first for resistance. However, armor can't block the magic damage from Rengar W Battle Roar.
Rengar.combo: When Rengar W Battle Roar is down and he has no Ferocity, place Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance on his escape route. Dodge Rengar E Bola Strike, then use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered basic attack. Use Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to finish Rengar once his health has decreased.
Rengar.escape: After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, you have a chance to reposition with Shaco Q Deceive. Once Rengar goes in, he has no skill to create distance on his own, so if Rengar W Battle Roar is also down, hold him with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box, then engage. If the kill isn't certain, save Shaco Q Deceive for escape.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar has no Ferocity. Once you've confirmed Rengar W Battle Roar is down, use the fear and damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box. If you engage with Shaco Q Deceive, it will be hard to escape that fight, so only go in when you can secure the kill.
Rengar.laning: Early on, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear camps safely and preserve your health. Avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is unseen, and place Shaco W Jack In The Box in front of the enemy camps to guard against an invade.
Rengar.phase: Shaco's burst is strongest in the mid game with two items, but avoid fights while Rengar has full Ferocity. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in solo fights, so create vision and engage angles with Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate.
Rengar.teamfight: Keep your backline from stepping ahead of the frontline, and meet Rengar's engage where you have vision. Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down, hold him with the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate. Shaco should avoid engaging from the front; use the clone to draw attention, then target the enemy backline from the flank.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and build Ferocity, so avoid paths beside brush when you can't see him. At full Ferocity, Rengar E Bola Strike roots and Rengar W Battle Roar removes crowd control, so avoid fighting him then. Don't roam alone while injured when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against Sejuani's main damage. Sejuani W Winter's Wrath deals physical damage, so magic resistance can't block it. Consider Quicksilver Sash if Sejuani's stuns and knockups keep locking you down.
Sejuani.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance on Sejuani's retreat path or in a brush. Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault has been used, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind her and land an empowered basic attack. Save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison while chasing, then throw it to finish once health has decreased.
Sejuani.escape: Right after baiting out Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is your window to engage. However, if Sejuani E Permafrost stacks are building or you're at high risk of being hit by Sejuani R Glacial Prison, save Shaco Q Deceive for escape. If you use Shaco Q Deceive to engage, you have no way to escape that fight, so only go in when you can secure the kill.
Sejuani.fight: While Sejuani P Fury of the North increases her defensive stats, deal damage first to create time for her Frost Armor to fall off. Approach from the flank after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, and land Shaco Q Deceive's empowered basic attack from behind. Hold Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison while chasing and use its slow on basic attacks, then throw it once the enemy's health has decreased.
Sejuani.laning: Early on, place Shaco W Jack In The Box first to clear jungle camps safely, then use your health for ganks and invades. Seek early jungle control and objectives so Sejuani doesn't have time to scale. Before starting an objective, place Shaco W Jack In The Box at an entrance Sejuani could use to get in.
Sejuani.phase: Shaco has strong burst in the mid game with two items, but if you give Sejuani time, she will build defensive stats and keep locking down your allies. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in solo fights, so disrupt vision and formation with Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate.
Sejuani.teamfight: Don't engage from the front where Sejuani's area crowd control can reach you; draw the fight toward terrain where you've placed Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance. Send the Shaco R Hallucinate clone toward the enemy backline to draw a response, then use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind them from the flank. Engage when the clone explodes and fears them, and the enemy carries step forward.
Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault dashes in and knocks you up, while Sejuani R Glacial Prison stuns in an area. Watch for their windups and dodge to the side. If stacks of Sejuani E Permafrost build up, immediately create distance. If Sejuani W Winter's Wrath's first hit lands, get out of range before the second hit.

Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Also get armor to deal with her basic attack damage. Buy Executioner's Calling early if healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis prevents you from finishing your intended target.
Shyvana.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box first on the enemy's retreat path or in a brush. Use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind Shyvana and land an empowered basic attack, then slow her with basic attacks while chasing and finish with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison. If Shyvana R Dragon's Descent brings her in, look for a fear with Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate after she lands.
Shyvana.escape: Your chance to engage is when Shyvana's Fury bar is empty and she can't transform. You can also counterattack after the transformation from Shyvana R Dragon's Descent ends and she returns to human form. However, once you engage with Shaco Q Deceive, you can't escape that fight, so first judge whether you can secure the kill.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury bar is empty or after the transformation from Shyvana R Dragon's Descent ends. Use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind her and land an empowered basic attack. Save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison while chasing, then use it to finish once health has decreased. If you aren't sure you can secure the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive for escape.
Shyvana.laning: Early on, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear camps safely and preserve your health.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, pressure Shyvana before she has stacks with ganks and invades. Shaco's burst is strongest in the mid game with two items, while Shyvana gets stronger as she builds stacks. In the late game, focus less on solo fights and use Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate to create vision and engage angles.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies aren't hit together by Shyvana R Dragon's Descent's path, Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, and Shyvana E Molten Burst. Draw the fight toward terrain where you've placed Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance, and send the Shaco R Hallucinate clone forward to draw attention. Use Shaco Q Deceive from the flank to target the enemy backline from behind.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is an unstoppable dash, so don't try to block it with Shaco W Jack In The Box while she's flying in. Fear her after she lands, then create distance to avoid the slow and max health damage from Shyvana E Molten Burst.

Skarner.build: Decide early whether to include Quicksilver Sash in your build to counter the suppression from Skarner R Impale. If you build resistance, prioritize magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid building health alone.
Skarner.combo: Once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, place Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance on his retreat path. Use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered basic attack, then keep attacking from behind to use Shaco P Backstab. Save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison while chasing, then throw it to finish Skarner once his health has decreased.
Skarner.escape: Engage right after you bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If Skarner R Impale is still available, carefully consider engaging, since you can't escape with Shaco Q Deceive after being suppressed. Also account for having no way to escape that fight if you used Shaco Q Deceive to engage.
Skarner.fight: Right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact has been used is your chance to close the distance with Shaco Q Deceive. Get behind him and land Shaco P Backstab and Q Deceive's empowered basic attack. Save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison while chasing to keep him slowed, then use it to finish. If Skarner still has his mobility skill and suppression, save Shaco Q Deceive for escape.
Skarner.laning: Early on, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear jungle camps safely and preserve your health. Place Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance in front of enemy camps and at objective entrances to spot approaches.
Skarner.phase: Early on, Shaco should clear camps safely, then slow Skarner's growth by gaining an advantage through ganks and invades. Shaco's burst is strongest in the mid game with two items, so take advantage of openings when Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in solo fights, and a scaled Skarner can survive for a long time and keep targets locked down, so disrupt vision and formation with Shaco W Jack In The Box and R Hallucinate.
Skarner.teamfight: Avoid engaging from the front and draw the fight toward terrain where you've placed Shaco W Jack In The Box in advance. Send the Shaco R Hallucinate clone toward the enemy backline to draw attention, then when Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down and the enemy carries step forward, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind them from the flank. At the edge of the dragon or Baron pit, don't stand against a wall, since Skarner R Impale can pull you inside.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain, and he stuns you if he grabs you and slams you into a wall, so don't stand with your back to a wall. If suppressed by Skarner R Impale, you can't escape with Shaco Q Deceive, so be wary before entering its short range. Taking repeated empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval at close range is increasingly dangerous, so keep outside melee range.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resist first against Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Consider Quicksilver Sash if you are often caught by immobilizing crowd control. If you are caught after using Shaco Q Deceive to engage, it is hard to get away.
Taliyah.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along Taliyah’s retreat path. When you can avoid the minefield, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind her and land an empowered basic attack. During the chase, save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to keep up the basic attack slow, then throw it to finish her when her health decreases.
Taliyah.escape: Look for an engage when you can avoid Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, and before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back up. If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth has been laid out, go around it rather than using Shaco Q Deceive across it. After engaging, use the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate to stop Taliyah from escaping.
