Taliyah.fight: Watch where Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is placed, then use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind her from an angle that avoids the minefield. Hit her from behind with an empowered basic attack that applies Shaco P Backstab, and use Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to finish once health has decreased. If you cannot secure the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive to escape.
Taliyah.laning: Early on, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear camps safely and preserve health for ganks. Before ganking, place Shaco W Jack In The Box along the enemy’s escape route.
Taliyah.phase: Mid-game, when you have two items, Shaco’s burst is strong, so get behind Taliyah when she is alone. In the late game, your solo dueling power falls off, so use Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate to create vision and an angle to engage.
Taliyah.teamfight: Avoid engaging head-on and draw the fight toward terrain where you have placed Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time. Send Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone toward the enemy backline to draw a reaction, then use Shaco Q Deceive from the opposite side to target Taliyah from behind. Also avoid areas covered by Taliyah E Unraveled Earth when you engage.
Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley cannot change direction while being cast, so dodge by moving sideways instead of straight toward her.

Udyr.build: If Udyr W Iron Mantle’s healing makes your burst insufficient, buy Executioner's Calling early. Prioritize armor for resistance, but armor alone cannot block all the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm and mixed damage from Udyr Q Wilding Claw.
Udyr.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along the enemy’s retreat route. When Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind him and land an empowered basic attack, then finish with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison. If Udyr is empowered by E, wait until the empowerment ends before engaging in hopes of fearing him.
Udyr.escape: The moment after you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your window to close the distance with Shaco Q Deceive. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede has already stunned you once, counterattack or retreat while that target cannot be stunned by it again for a while. When escaping, do not try to run on foot; save Shaco Q Deceive, and use Shaco W Jack In The Box or the fear from Shaco R Hallucinate after Udyr’s E empowerment ends.
Udyr.fight: Briefly burst Udyr when Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone to leave him less time to heal. During a chase, save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to maintain the basic attack slow, then throw it to finish him when his health drops.
Udyr.laning: Early on, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear jungle camps safely and preserve your health. Place boxes at key paths and jungle entrances to track Udyr’s movements, and avoid pushing forward recklessly when he is out of sight.
Udyr.phase: Mid-game, when you have two items, Shaco’s burst is at its strongest, so target a weaker enemy when Udyr’s engage is down. In the late game, Shaco’s solo dueling power falls off, so use boxes and your clone to create vision and an angle to engage.
Udyr.teamfight: Do not try to burst down Udyr first when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield. Lead with Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone to draw attention and fight in terrain where you have placed boxes, while your real body targets the enemy backline from the side.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede closes the distance quickly and stuns, so keep your distance just after he activates a stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered attacks and Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage scale with your maximum health, so do not fight him for long.

Vi.build: Vi’s primary damage is physical, so build armor first. Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on your maximum health and reduces your armor, so avoid relying on a large amount of health alone. Consider Quicksilver Sash if the enemy team has a lot of immobilizing crowd control.
Vi.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along Vi’s retreat path. When Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind her and land an empowered basic attack, then finish with Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison when health has dropped. If Vi catches you with Vi R Cease and Desist, respond with Shaco W Jack In The Box after she lands and finishes knocking you up, not during the dash.
Vi.escape: The moment after Vi Q Vault Breaker is down is your chance to close the distance with Shaco Q Deceive. However, if Vi R Cease and Desist is still available, she cannot be stopped during the dash, and using Shaco Q Deceive to engage leaves you without an escape for that fight. If you cannot secure the kill, save Shaco Q Deceive to escape.
Vi.fight: Fight briefly right after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker or making her use it. Use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind her and land an empowered basic attack, and save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to finish her when her health has dropped. Break off long fights as Vi W Denting Blows stacks and create distance.
Vi.laning: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along the enemy’s retreat route, then use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind them. Look for a chance to make Vi use Vi Q Vault Breaker before you approach her.
Vi.phase: Mid-game, Shaco’s burst is strong with two items, so make a brief engage while Vi Q Vault Breaker is down. In the late game, Shaco’s solo dueling power falls off, so use Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate to disrupt vision and create opportunities.
Vi.teamfight: Do not engage head-on; draw the fight toward terrain where you have placed Shaco W Jack In The Box. Lead with Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone to draw attention, then target the enemy backline from the side. While Vi R Cease and Desist is available, do not go out of vision alone; stay within range of an ally’s protection spell.
Vi.watch: When Vi starts charging Vi Q Vault Breaker, move back or sideways to dodge it. Vi R Cease and Desist chases its target to the end and cannot be stopped during the dash, so respond after she lands and finishes knocking you up. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor and increases her attack speed with repeated hits, so do not fight her for long.

Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If a long duel makes healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King a problem, consider buying Executioner's Calling early. Also consider Quicksilver Sash if Viego W Spectral Maw’s stun makes it hard to escape after engaging.
Viego.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along Viego’s retreat route. Before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back up, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered basic attack. Throw Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to finish him when his health has dropped.
Viego.escape: If only Viego W Spectral Maw is down, he can still escape with Viego R Heartbreaker, so do not engage right away. Engage when Viego R Heartbreaker is not back up yet and you have also avoided Viego W Spectral Maw’s stun. Using Shaco Q Deceive to engage makes it hard to escape that fight, so save it for your exit if the kill is uncertain.
Viego.fight: Viego gains an advantage when he gets a takedown, so avoid skirmishes you cannot finish decisively. Look for an opening before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back up, then use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind him and land an empowered basic attack. During a chase, save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to maintain the basic attack slow, then throw it to finish when health has dropped.
Viego.laning: Early on, use Shaco W Jack In The Box to clear jungle camps safely and preserve health for ganks. Do not push the lane toward the direction where Viego E Harrowed Path is visible; avoid that path or check it with a Control Ward. Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time in a brush or jungle entrance the enemy may pass through to watch for an approach.
Viego.phase: Mid-game, Shaco’s burst peaks with two items, so look for a target you can pick off without giving Viego a takedown. In the late game, Shaco’s solo dueling power falls off, so use boxes and your clone to disrupt vision and create a place to fight.
Viego.teamfight: If an ally falls in front of Viego, do not keep fighting there; use the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box to block Viego’s path to the soul. Lead with Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone to draw attention, while your real body uses Shaco Q Deceive from the side to target an opening in the enemy backline. If Viego possesses someone, create distance and hold out, then counterattack when he returns to his original body.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged, so dodge to the side when you see him charging. If Viego E Harrowed Path is visible on terrain, watch for a camouflaged Viego approaching and avoid that path. When your health is low, retreat because you can be targeted by Viego R Heartbreaker.

Warwick.build: Build magic resist first against the damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. Armor also helps against his basic attack physical damage. If his healing makes it hard to finish him, get Executioner's Calling early.
Warwick.combo: Place Shaco W Jack In The Box ahead of time along Warwick’s retreat route or in a brush. After Warwick E Primal Howl’s fear triggers, use Shaco Q Deceive to appear behind him and land an empowered basic attack. During a chase, save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to maintain the basic attack slow, then throw it to finish him when his health has dropped.
Warwick.escape: Do not engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Wait until before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up and after Warwick E Primal Howl’s fear triggers, then use Shaco Q Deceive to close the distance. At that moment, use Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate to pressure his escape route.
Warwick.fight: Keep your distance while Warwick E Primal Howl is active, then re-engage after the fear triggers. Use Shaco Q Deceive to get behind him and land an empowered basic attack, and save Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison to finish Warwick after his health has dropped. Given Warwick’s healing, use Shaco Q Deceive to engage only when you can secure the kill; otherwise, save it to escape.
